touches.text: Seals: one current validation per proof, beside the proof. A seal holds while the code it measured is unchanged.
scratch: a proof's throwaway temp dirs and worktrees, cleaned up by the door. WHY: a run must leave nothing behind (4.3.1.7). USERS: the tester.

What the waker starts outlives whoever started it (detached, or through systemd-run --user, which gives it its own memory cap and log while still deciding nothing). Restarting a shim never takes down the bus it once woke.
pulse.py is part of the shim. The ground loop calling it tells the shim the pulse has arrived, and starts the shim if it isn't running.
Owns the CC launcher (superclaude): starts Claude Code with Cairn's session contract, in its own memory-capped cgroup. WHY: Claude can OOM the box.
bus_client: gets a process onto the bus (reach a device, or connect). Its connect is a wake attempt (5.3.5.1). USERS: every process that speaks.
